typeProperties.script:
source(output(
		RowNumber as integer,
		ProgramText as string,
		Region as string,
		MemberID as string,
		OverdueService as string,
		MemberName as string,
		BirthDate as string,
		Age as string,
		HEDISAge as string,
		Gender as string,
		Ethnicity as string,
		Address1 as string,
		Address2 as string,
		Address3 as string,
		City as string,
		State as string,
		Zip as string,
		County as string,
		MemberPhone as string,
		LanguagePreference as string,
		ProviderID as string,
		ProviderName as string,
		ProviderPhone as string
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false,
	isolationLevel: 'READ_UNCOMMITTED',
	query: 'select * from [dbo].[Stage_EPSDTTN180DReportData] where Region = ?',
	format: 'query',
	staged:false) ~> OLEDBSource
OLEDBSource derive({Copy of MemberName} = toString(MemberName),
		{Copy of Address2} = toString(Address2),
		{Copy of Address1} = toString(Address1),
		{Copy of Region} = toString(Region),
		{Copy of LanguagePreference} = toString(LanguagePreference),
		{Copy of Gender} = toString(Gender),
		{Copy of ProviderPhone} = toString(ProviderPhone),
		{Copy of ProgramText} = toString(ProgramText),
		{Copy of Address3} = toString(Address3),
		{Copy of State} = toString(State),
		{Copy of Ethnicity} = toString(Ethnicity),
		{Copy of ProviderName} = toString(ProviderName),
		{Copy of BirthDate} = toString(BirthDate),
		{Copy of City} = toString(City),
		{Copy of ProviderID} = toString(ProviderID),
		{Copy of County} = toString(County),
		{Copy of MemberID} = toString(MemberID),
		{Copy of RowNumber} = RowNumber,
		{Copy of HEDISAge} = toString(HEDISAge),
		{Copy of Zip} = toString(Zip),
		{Copy of Age} = toString(Age),
		{Copy of OverdueService} = toString(OverdueService),
		{Copy of MemberPhone} = toString(MemberPhone)) ~> DataConversion
DataConversion sink(input(
		{} as string
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false) ~> ExcelDestination
